module_node_type.description: Tree-sitter root node type (e.g. 'module' for Python, 'source_file' for Solidity).

dependency_paths.description: Directory names pruned during the initial repo walk (Phase 3 uses these too).

name_field_multiple.description: If true, treat name_field as multi-valued: emit one definition per identifier child of that field. Used for Go's `var a, b int` / `const x, y = 1, 2`.

qualified_name_prefix_from_field.description: Optional. Descend the named field on the def node looking for the first type_identifier and insert it as a prefix segment immediately before the def's own name. Used for Go method receivers: `func (d *Dog) Bark()` → `<file>.Dog.Bark`.

exclude_parent_field.description: Skip when this node sits in the named field of a given parent type (e.g. 'function_definition.name').

name_field.description: If the function expression has its own name field (e.g. emit_statement.name), use that instead.

write_when_parent_field.description: Reference is a write when the node sits in this parent field (e.g. 'assignment.left').

imports.description: Phase 3: which AST nodes are imports. The actual extraction logic is per-language Python code in core/heuristic_resolver.py — this block lists the node types so the resolver knows what to look for.

external_prefixes.description: Path prefixes that classify an import as external (e.g. '@' for npm scoped packages).

inheritance.description: How class/contract/interface/struct inheritance is shaped in the AST. May be a single rule object (Python, Solidity) or an array of rules when one parent node type has multiple inheritance shapes (Go: same `type_spec` parent for both interface embedding and struct embedding).

parent_node_types.description: AST node types that can declare bases (e.g. 'contract_declaration', 'class_definition').

child_node_type.description: Solidity-style: parent has multiple direct children of this type, each holding one base.

child_name_field.description: Solidity-style: field on `child_node_type` whose subtree resolves to the base identifier.

bases_field.description: Python-style: field on `parent_node_type` pointing at a list-like node whose identifier children are the bases.

child_via_field.description: Optional intermediate field on the parent. When set, the resolver descends parent → field → that node's children before applying child_node_type. Used for AST shapes where bases live one node deeper than the parent (Go interface embedding: type_spec.type → interface_type.type_elem).

child_via_node_type.description: Optional. After `child_via_field`, descend into the first child whose type matches this. Used when there are TWO levels of indirection between the parent and the iteration target (Go struct embedding: type_spec.type → struct_type → field_declaration_list → field_declaration).

child_only_when_field_absent.description: Optional. When iterating `child_node_type`, skip children that have a value for this named field. Used to filter Go struct's embedded fields (which lack a `name`) from regular named fields.
